candidates.name: Shivam Chhirolya
candidates.headline: Founding AI Engineer at Contrails.AI | IISc M.Tech AI (2nd Rank) | Computer Vision & LLM Systems
candidates.summary: IISc-trained AI engineer (M.Tech, 2nd rank cohort) with ~4 years spanning Qualcomm R&D, LLM product at Prezent.AI, and a current founding engineering role at Contrails.AI. Builds production AI systems — deepfake detection, autonomous agents, multimodal moderation — with quantified outcomes and a pending US patent. Rare blend of research depth and startup execution speed.
candidates.narrative: Shivam Chhirolya is a high-caliber AI engineer with approximately four years of professional experience spanning computer vision R&D at Qualcomm, LLM product work at Prezent.AI, and a current founding engineering role at Contrails.AI. He holds an M.Tech in Artificial Intelligence from IISc Bangalore — graduating 2nd in his cohort — backed by a 99.60th percentile GATE score and selection into the Reliance Foundation's top-40 national scholarship, signals of exceptional raw ability. His career arc shows deliberate progression from deep CV and hardware simulation work at a Fortune 500 to increasingly autonomous, ownership-heavy AI engineering. At Contrails.AI he is building deepfake detection infrastructure and agentic intelligence systems from scratch for high-trust clients including India's PMO, MIB, and Reliance Industries — a zero-safety-net founding environment. He ships with hard metrics: 95%+ deepfake detection accuracy on a self-curated 100K video dataset, autonomous agent expansion from 31 to 1,400+ Telegram channels tracing 27K+ network events, and a pending US patent for compression artifact reduction. Published at BMVC'22, his research credentials reinforce the technical depth behind his execution. The combination of foundational research, production MLOps fluency, and willingness to take founding-level risk makes Shivam a rare profile.
candidates.raw_text: M.Tech in Artificial Intelligence from IISc Bangalore (2nd Rank, CGPA 8.30/10). Founding AI Engineer at Contrails.AI building deepfake detection and agentic AI systems for Government of India and Reliance Industries. Previously Sr. ML Engineer at Prezent.AI and Computer Vision & ML Engineer at Qualcomm R&D. US Patent pending. Published at BMVC'22. 99.60th percentile GATE 2020. Reliance Foundation Scholar (Top 40 nationwide).

candidate_experiences.description: Six-week internship at BrahMos Aerospace (DRDO), Delhi. No technical detail provided in resume.

candidate_experiences.title: Intern, Multimedia Team
candidate_experiences.description: Designed Deep Learning based post-processing algorithms reducing video compression artifacts from HEVC decoder by 6%. Used Inception blocks to reduce learnable parameters by 2x.
candidate_experiences.note: Foundation for later full-time offer and US patent submission.

candidate_experiences.title: Computer Vision & ML Engineer
candidate_experiences.description: Developed novel hybrid Keypoints Detector combining classical CV and CNNs, improving Inlier Ratio by 20% and Repeatability by 40% with only 5K learnable parameters — led to published research paper. Explored Stable Diffusion with ControlNets for depth-to-image generation. Implemented C++ end-to-end software simulator for classical CV algorithms for Qualcomm Premium Tier chips with 100% accuracy. Designed CNN Inception/GoogLeNet-based InLoop filter reducing HEVC compression artifacts by 10%; resulted in US patent submission (under review).
candidate_experiences.note: 1 US patent filed · 1 internal research pub (Qbuzz'23)

candidate_experiences.title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
candidate_experiences.description: Integrated AI Agents with contextual intelligence using LLMs to automate PowerPoint generation from user prompts via web scraping, summarization, RAG, and vector DB — achieving 95% content accuracy. Worked on AlphaEvolve coding agent for Aspose pptx code generation. Fine-tuned Cross Encoder Qwen3B LLM for reranking. Utilized Anthropic Claude models via AWS/S3 and optimized inference pipelines. Built Gradio testing interfaces and deployed FastAPI LLM-powered APIs.

candidate_experiences.title: Founding AI Engineer
candidate_experiences.description: Architected 3-branch VLM deepfake detection framework from scratch and curated a 100K+ real-world video dataset; fine-tuned CLIP ViT-L/14 to 95%+ accuracy across 25+ generators. Built production-grade multimodal moderation systems using Gemini 2.5 Flash and Qwen2.5-VL for Government of India agencies (PMO, MIB) and Reliance Industries brand protection workflows. Designed autonomous LangGraph-based AI agents scaling from 31 seed channels to 1,400+ Telegram communities, tracing 27K+ network events for enforcement intelligence reports. MLOps: AWS, FastAPI, Docker, TensorRT, CI/CD, DDP, GPU inference optimization.
candidate_experiences.note: Govt of India (PMO, MIB) + Reliance Industries clients from day one

candidate_projects.name: Low-Light Video Enhancement via Cross-Frame Attention
candidate_projects.summary: Novel Transformer-based framework for low-light video enhancement using cross-frame attention; achieved 30% SSIM improvement and 300% ST-RRED reduction. Introduced dilated cross-attention for large motion handling (3× improvement). Created custom dataset with 200+ synthetic and real low-light video sequences. Published at BMVC'22.

candidate_projects.name: Deepfake Detection — 3-Branch VLM Framework
candidate_projects.summary: Architected a 3-branch Vision-Language Model framework for deepfake detection from scratch at Contrails.AI. Curated 100K+ real-world video dataset and fine-tuned CLIP ViT-L/14 to 95%+ accuracy across 25+ deepfake generators. Deployed in production for Government of India (PMO, MIB) and Reliance Industries.
